issues.legal_issue: The National Green Tribunal must comply with the principles of natural justice by notifying or hearing persons likely to be adversely affected by its directions.
The National Green Tribunal cannot disregard a final decree of a competent court that has conclusively determined the rights of the same parties concerning the same land.

The National Green Tribunal’s rejection of review petitions is unsustainable when it fails to consider material facts, including an applicable development plan and prior litigation concerning the land.
The precise boundaries of the lake must be determined through a properly constituted committee and reconsidered by the National Green Tribunal after hearing affected parties.
